summary: MaxsMaking Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy form. The meeting, scheduled for September 28, 2026, will consider resolutions to (1) amend the memorandum and articles to remove Class B shares and create a single class of Class A shares, and (2) approve a continuation from the British Virgin Islands to Delaware for domestication as a Delaware corporation. This is a routine corporate governance/reorganization step, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or acquisition-related details are present. The filing is procedural, with no impact on shareholders' economic rights.
